description: NVL2(expr1, expr2, expr3) - expr2 when expr1 is NOT NULL, else expr3. Works over columns and accepts a NULL third branch. Converted 1:1 from functions/Nvl2Test (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER, phone VARCHAR)
SELECT NVL2(phone, 'has phone', 'no phone') FROM t WHERE id = 1
SELECT NVL2(phone, 'has phone', 'no phone') FROM t WHERE id = 2
